property_summary: For any caller who is the owner and when the contract holds a positive balance, calling withdrawAll(recipient) transfers the contract's entire ETH balance to recipient (so address(c).balance becomes zero); the mutant that always transfers 0 breaks this by leaving address(c).balance > 0 for some inputs.
change_summary: Change transfer to send zero value by using address(0).balance subtraction style resulting in no funds transferred (effectively a no-op transfer).
